title: consolidate-reauth-and-generator-stream-sugar-ts-sdk
author: Aisha Patel
description: Introduce a compact reauth/fallback orchestration and ergonomic generator-based streaming helpers for the TypeScript SDK. This PR consolidates three internal reauth paths into a single lightweight credential fallback registry, surfaces typed async-generator helpers with backpressure hints, and aligns retry presets with the Python/Go SDKs. Motivation: customer reports and internal benchmarks showed frequent developer confusion when wiring reauth callbacks and inconsistent retry defaults across languages. Goals: 1) provide a single credential fallback API that supports synchronous and async token providers, 2) add typed GeneratorStream helpers that simplify cancel/abort handling and expose a backpressure hint API, 3) converge retry presets to the cross-SDK matrix and bump package to v1.29.0, 4) keep migration surface minimal with clear deprecation shims. The description includes implementation notes, test/CI changes, and a brief migration guide.
